0.headline: Jio IPO 'very, very big', highlights depth of India's capital markets: HDFC AMC's Navneet Munot
0.heading: Jio IPO 'very, very big', highlights depth of India's capital markets: HDFC AMC's Navneet Munot
0.intro: Jio Platforms (JPL), the parent of telecom operator Reliance Jio Infocomm, plans to raise Rs 30,187.6 crore through its maiden public offering, adjusted for the Rs 54-per-share discount offered to employees
0.body:
HDFC AMC MD &amp; CEO Navneet Munot on Monday said that Jio's upcoming IPO highlights the potential of India's capital markets to raise large amounts of capital.

Speaking to CNBC-TV18, Munot complimented the company for creating value through large investments over the past decade.

"It (Jio IPO) is the really, very, very big one. It shows the potential of the Indian market that you can raise a couple of billion dollars from India's capital market," he said.

Munot added: "Also, compliments to somebody who made such a large bet 10 years back, investing billions of dollars, and within 10 years, you are able to raise this kind of equity and create this value. Compliments to them."

#JioPlatforms IPO
Navneet Munot Of HDFC Asset Management Company To @CNBCTV18News

- This IPO shows the potential of the Indian market
- Compliments to the mgmt for raising this kind of equity within 10 years

@prashantnair #CNBCTV18Market #JioIPO #RelianceIndustries #Telecom https://t.co/gJ2fG52g4G

— CNBC-TV18 (@CNBCTV18News) October 19, 2026


He advised entrepreneurs to look at the long-term potential of India, innovate and invest more because the markets are giving them an opportunity to raise capital.

Jio Platforms (JPL), the parent of telecom operator Reliance Jio Infocomm, plans to raise Rs 30,187.6 crore through its maiden public offering, adjusted for the Rs 54-per-share discount offered to employees. The issue comprises an entirely fresh issuance of 27 crore equity shares, making it the largest IPO in India's equity market by issue size.

Before the Jio Platforms IPO, Hyundai Motor India's Rs 27,859-crore IPO, launched in 2024, was the country's largest public issue. It was followed by the National Stock Exchange's Rs 22,563-crore offer in 2026 and Life Insurance Corporation of India's Rs 20,557-crore IPO in 2022.

The Jio Platforms IPO's anchor book opened for one day on October 19 and is expected to attract around Rs 8,000 crore.


Jio IPO पर Trust Mutual Fund के CIO मिहिर वोरा

टेलीकॉम सेक्टर में कंसोलिडेशन, बढ़ती प्राइसिंग पावर, AI और डेटा सेंटर की मांग से ग्रोथ के नए मौके बन रहे हैं। वैल्यूएशन भी आकर्षक, सेक्टर पर नजरिया पॉजिटिव!- मिहिर वोरा

@_anujsinghal @theMihirV #JioIPO #IPO #Stockmarket https://t.co/rYSmaL8ocw

— CNBC-AWAAZ (@CNBC_Awaaz) October 19, 2026




Meanwhile, speaking to CNBC-Awaaz on Jio's IPO, Trust Mutual Fund CIO Mihir Vora struck a positive note on the telecom sector, citing improving pricing power, consolidation and emerging growth opportunities in areas like AI.

"The cutthroat competition in the industry is not there anymore. It is now a market of 3-4 major players ... pricing power has come and valued added services are being introduced," Vora said.

"Moreover, the demand for AI and data centre is growing, along with services for the B2B sector. I believe the pricing power and the incremental growth opportunities are increasing in the telecom sector now," he added.

"This sector, I feel, is overall positive. It has not outperformed as much, which is why a good value has been created," Vora said.

1.headline: Jio Platforms IPO: Why brokerages recommend 'subscribe'
1.heading: Jio Platforms IPO: Why brokerages recommend 'subscribe'
1.intro: Going forward, the company’s large subscriber base and pricing power position it for growth
1.body:
Analysts have recommended that investors subscribe to Jio Platforms’ upcoming initial public offering (IPO). The firm's growth ambitions in the telecom business and its expansion plans across broadband, enterprise services and artificial intelligence (AI) segments have drawn bullish calls.

Going forward, the company’s large subscriber base and pricing power position it for growth. However, execution, regulation and capital expenditure remain key monitorables.


What's driving the bullishness?
The key driver of optimism is Jio Platforms' sheer scale. The firm has 533.3 million subscribers as of June 2026 and accounted for around 60% of India’s wireless data traffic. Further, Jio holds India’s largest spectrum bank at 26,800.8 MHz.

Brokerages noted that Jio aims to maintain its leadership in digital connectivity through accelerating the migration of 2G users to 4G/5G networks, expanding its home broadband business and monetising its proprietary technology platforms.

"Since its launch in 2016, [Jio Platforms] has reshaped India’s telecom landscape over the past decade through disruptive pricing and differentiated offering," said PhilipCapital.

The firm's financial performance has also added to the positive sentiment. From FY16 to FY26, Jio Platform’s revenue grew to Rs 1,46,885 crore and EBITDA to Rs 73,400 crore, translating into a healthy ~50% EBITDA margin.
Beyond telecom
Beyond mobile connectivity, Jio is scaling home broadband, enterprise technology and AI-led services. The firm is also pushing for the bundling of OTT entertainment, cloud storage, gaming and AI-based services into its telecom plans.

Home broadband is a key growth driver, with JioFiber and JioAirFiber positioned to capitalize on India’s low fixed broadband penetration of approximately 21% in FY26, which is projected to reach around 46% by FY31. As of June 2026, it had 28.6 million fixed broadband customers, including 14.0 million JioAirFiber subscribers.

Jio has developed an end-to-end proprietary 5G standalone stack and filed 7,220 patent applications across 4G, 5G, 6G, AI and digital technologies. "Jio’s in-house technology capabilities provide an important competitive advantage by supporting innovation, operational efficiency and greater control over its digital infrastructure," said SMC Global Securities.
Valuations
The proposed price band of Rs 1,065-1,119 per share implies a post-issue market capitalization of Rs 9.8 lakh crore to Rs 10.3 lakh crore. The offer is expected to raise Rs 28,800-30,200 crore, of which ~Rs 27,500 crore would be utilized towards prepayment of borrowings availed by Reliance Jio Infocomm, with the balance, not exceeding 25% of gross proceeds, earmarked for general corporate purposes.

"In our view, the combination of potential tariff-led earnings growth, organic ARPU expansion and multiple new digital-service revenue streams provides sufficient headroom for earnings to compound, making the IPO valuation attractive on a forward-looking basis," said PhilipCapital.

Emkay Global added that the issue was reasonably priced, given Jio Platforms' market leadership, pricing power, growth levers and execution record, adding, "With a proven execution record and cash generation strengthening as the 5G investment cycle winds down."

According to SBICAPS, the issue pricing reflects the firm's scale, earnings growth, technology capabilities and long-term monetisation potential. "The proposed repayment of the borrowings is expected to lower leverage and finance costs, strengthen cash flows and provide financial flexibility for future investments."

2.headline: Subscribe for Jio Platforms Ltd IPO; Anand Rathi
2.heading: Subscribe for Jio Platforms Ltd IPO; Anand Rathi
2.intro: Anand Rathi, has come out with its report on Jio Platforms Ltd The research firm has recommended to “ Subscribe” the ipo in its research report as on October 16, 2026.
2.body:
Anand Rathi, Jio Platforms Ltd
Incorporated on November 15, 2019, Jio Platforms Limited is a technology company focused on digital connectivity, digital services and technologyled solutions in India. The Company has built a comprehensive digital ecosystem supported by proprietary technology capabilities and pan-India connectivity infrastructure, enabling it to deliver integrated digital services to both consumers and businesses. Its subsidiary, Reliance Jio Infocomm Limited, served 533.3 million customers as of June 30, 2026, providing a substantial customer base for the expansion of its digital offerings. Jio Platforms operates through an integrated technology platform spanning digital connectivity, consumer applications, enterprise solutions, cloud services, Internet of Things (IoT) and artificial intelligence (AI). Its consumer portfolio includes mobile and fixed broadband services, digital entertainment, cloud storage, virtual PC services and smart home solutions. On the enterprise side, the Company offers connectivity, cloud and security solutions, managed services, IoT applications and AI-based solutions, catering to the evolving technology requirements of businesses. Its proprietary technology capabilities extend across network infrastructure, device engineering, software, operating systems and digital applications, supporting the development and delivery of integrated digital solutions.

Valuation and Outlook
At the upper issue price, the company is valued at 34.3x FY2026 P/E and 14.8x FY2026 EV/EBITDA, implying a market capitalization of approximately ₹10,304,905 million. Considering its leadership position in India's digital ecosystem, strong profitability, scalable technology platform, robust growth prospects and significant opportunities in AI, enterprise digital services and fixed broadband, the valuation appears reasonable relative to its long-term growth potential. Accordingly, we recommend a "Subscribe – Long Term" rating for the issue.
